boundary: All translations fixed only on rear n=18 mm solid contact within x [-5.5,29.5], s [-17,11] mm. Ideal fully bonded rigid hinge-web patch. No real joint or lip validation.
load: Book fraction 70%; positive maximum-entropy front pressure over solid intersection of x [-65.5,89.5], s [-161,59] mm, matching book COM force and moment. Pressure centroid x=12, s=-51-(book thickness/2)*tan(angle). Downslope lip transfer Gaussian sigma=3 mm at s=-161 mm on front face, x centroid=12. Exact own weight body force included.
sampling: Angles 30 through 75 degrees, inclusive, at 5-degree increments. Book thicknesses 25 and 50 mm. Reported envelope is maximum among sampled cases only, not proof of continuum maximum.
scope: Small-strain homogeneous isotropic 3D elasticity, constant 4 mm thickness, quadratic 10-node tetrahedra. Sharp clamp edges included in nodal stress max; can exhibit mesh sensitivity. Leaf only, no joint/lip/stand/base qualification.
stressInterpretation: The full nodal peak rises at the sharp ideal clamp boundary and is not mesh converged. Do not use it as a converged joint-strength prediction or a pass claim. Peak stress is retained in diagnostic data only; it must not be presented as a validated product-strength value.
